# Auto Lien Tracker

> Automated auto-insurance verification and lapse detection for lenders. Auto Lien Tracker continuously monitors borrower insurance policies for Buy-Here-Pay-Here (BHPH) dealers, banks, and credit unions, alerting lienholders the moment coverage lapses or a lienholder is removed — so collateral is never silently unprotected.

Auto Lien Tracker is a SaaS platform that connects to insurance carriers, verifies active coverage, confirms the lender is listed as lienholder, and surfaces compliance issues on a real-time dashboard. It also offers a partner REST API so dealer management systems (DMS) and CRMs can push funded deals and receive verification status via webhooks.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://autolientracker.com/): Overview of automated insurance monitoring for lenders.
- [Features](https://autolientracker.com/#features): Borrower intake & OCR, carrier verification, and a compliance dashboard.
- [Pricing](https://autolientracker.com/#pricing): Plans for dealers, banks, and credit unions.
- [Integrations](https://autolientracker.com/#integrations): Partner API and DMS/CRM connections.

## How it works

- Borrower intake collects insurance details via a secure link, with OCR of insurance documents.
- Carrier verification confirms active coverage and lienholder status with supported insurers.
- A compliance dashboard flags lapses, expirations, and missing-lienholder issues in real time.
- Webhooks notify connected partner systems when a policy's verification status changes.

## For partners and developers

- [Partner API integration guide](https://autolientracker.com/partners): How a DMS or CRM pushes deals and receives status webhooks.
- API base URL: https://api.autolientracker.com
- Authentication uses per-dealership API keys (`alt_live_…` for production, `alt_test_…` for sandbox/testing).
